evidence.detail: WHITELIST and PROFANITY_BLACKLIST are static Python lists in source; no DB-backed admin interface exists
Issue body itself says 'maybe our blacklist (and whitelist) could live in the db' — persistent per-deck flagging requires a new DB table

triage.notes: Implementation requires at minimum a new DB table for admin-flagged deck names and an admin UI endpoint; the issue also proposes user-flagging for mod review, which widens scope further.
